# Import fidelity API recordings

Projected public GitHub issue and closure-timeline responses for the six consumer sync PRs, recorded on 2026-10-16 UTC. Issue numbers, states, reasons and lifecycle dates are retained verbatim. Bodies, labels and assignment data are reduced to synthetic context; no operational or personal data is required. GraphQL recordings preserve the closing PR or commit when GitHub identifies one.

The HTTP replay drives the real importer and the installed PM SDK against disposable Git trackers. The release-window test creates one lightweight and one annotated calendar tag with controlled Git dates; it renders the actual pm-changelog CLI output.
